areas.name: Environmental sustainability, adaptation and mitigation
areas.reason: Reforestation as compensation for works and agricultural reuse of sewage sludge as fertilizer reduce chemical fertilizer use.

areas.name: Basic sanitation
areas.reason: Expansion and upgrading of sewerage systems to raise urban sewerage coverage.

areas.name: Biodiversity and forest resources
areas.reason: Native-species reforestation in a very-high-priority conservation area, with maintenance until vegetation establishes.

areas.name: Energy efficiency and renewable energy
areas.reason: Proponent presented no information to score the criterion.

areas.name: Integrated water-resources management and water security
areas.reason: Water-security benefits are indirect effects of sewerage works; no integrated water-resources management actions exist.

areas.name: Business environment and opportunities
areas.reason: Information insufficient; could not conclude that sludge reuse creates new business opportunities.

areas.name: Individual entrepreneurs and micro/small firms
areas.reason: Cost savings for farmers using sludge are not a reasonable justification for the criterion.

areas.name: Jobs and income for low-income and vulnerable groups
areas.reason: A professional course for women could not be shown to generate jobs and income in the intervention areas.

areas.name: Infrastructure and social facilities for low-income and vulnerable groups
areas.reason: No infrastructure or facilities specifically aimed at low-income groups; community engagement activities do not qualify.

areas.name: Inclusion of social minorities
areas.reason: Social-tariff enrollment activities only; no actual tariff adoption planned, so inclusion effect is indirect.

areas.name: Youth, gender and race policies
areas.reason: Training course for women is not an effective inclusion measure compared with e.g. hiring in works.

areas.name: Public-service delivery, management and citizen participation
areas.reason: Community relations programme shows no significant innovation or improvement in service delivery; information insufficient.

areas.name: Education and health conditions
areas.reason: Environmental education activities not shown to yield direct education benefits in the strict sense.

areas.name: Technological development, innovation and modernization
areas.reason: Museum equipment upgrade not shown to generate technological development or innovation.

areas.name: Financing arrangements encouraging private participation
areas.reason: Intention to use performance, turnkey or leasing contract models wherever possible was considered insufficient.
